title: Did AI Just Prove the Riemann Hypothesis? Inside the 17-Million-Line Lean Claim
description_html:
An Anthropic researcher says he and Claude have found a proof of the Riemann hypothesis, written as about 17 million lines of Lean code that a computer can check. We explain what the hypothesis is, why it carries a 1 million dollar prize, what experts such as Kevin Buzzard and Abhishek Saha say, what is still unverified, and why it matters from the United States to India. Claude is made by Anthropic, the researcher's employer, so treat the enthusiasm with care. This is the first main story from our Daily Crux of 23 November.

Sources: Levent Alpoge's published explanation and public comments by Kevin Buzzard and Abhishek Saha, as reported. Claims labelled as reported or alleged are not verified by us.
